home.faq.a1: Auto brings together your quotes, invoices, suppliers, job sites and documents. You stay in control of checks and validations. Tracking excl. VAT per job site covers the documents assigned to it; it does not replace a net margin calculation that includes all your charges.
home.faq.a2: You can start on the website from your browser, with an auto account. In a compatible browser, add the app to your home screen or install it from the browser menu. A local installation and connecting your folders are prepared with your IT support.
home.faq.a3: Depending on the configured services, auto reads the information on received invoices and quotes to help you enter it. You check the amounts and lines, fix errors and validate. An extracted document is not an invoice issued automatically.
home.faq.a4: Auto produces invoices in the Factur-X format. The connection to an approved platform is being qualified; we do not present it as a service that is already open. Stripe payments are currently in test mode.
home.faq.a5: Exports let you retrieve your data and documents according to your permissions. Workspaces have Excel and PDF exports, among others; a job site's analytics can also be exported as CSV. See the conditions of each plan on the Pricing page.
